newsitem.title: POLAND: Pre-war Jewish tombstones destroyed in Poland.
newsitem.headline: Pre-war Jewish tombstones destroyed in Poland.

text.p: Vandals have destroyed 43 marble and granite tombstones in a pre-World War Two Jewish cemetery in the southern Polish town of Oswiecim, police said on Tuesday.

Andrzej Sarlej, duty officer at Bielsko-Biala provincial police headquarters, told Reuters the damage was discovered by a caretaker late on Tuesday afternoon and the police suspected the destruction was carried out between November 2 and November 5.
"Forty-three tombstones have been broken or tipped over...we are investigating the case but we don't know who could have done this...there are no signs nor slogans," Sarlej said.

He said the cemetery was located in the centre of Oswiecim, several kilometres (miles) away from the the Auschwitz former death camp, where World War Two Nazi German occupiers murdered up to 1.5 million people, mostly Jews.
